name: Tasks App — transcripts to Linear issues
description: Local Next.js tool that browses a folder of meeting transcripts, extracts action items with a local Ollama model or the Claude API, lets the user edit them, and creates them as issues in Linear. Runs on port 3300. UI copy in Spanish; extracted tasks in English.

userStories.title: Project setup: typecheck gate, port 3300, data folder
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the project baseline in place so every later story has a working quality gate.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json has a `typecheck` script running `tsc --noEmit`
package.json `dev` script runs Next on port 3300 (`next dev -p 3300`)
`yaml` is installed as a dependency (used later for frontmatter parsing)
.gitignore includes `.data/` so local config and history are never committed
A `.data/` folder is created at runtime if missing, not committed to git
pnpm typecheck passes

userStories.title: Config store: read/write local JSON state
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a persistence layer so settings and push history survive restarts.
acceptanceCriteria: Module `lib/store.ts` reads and writes `.data/config.json`

Shape includes: `recentFolders: string[]`, `contextRoot: string | null`, `provider: 'ollama' | 'claude'`, `ollamaModel: string`, `claudeApiKey: string`, `linearApiKey: string`, `lastProjectId: string | null`
Shape includes `history: Record<string, { pushedAt: string; issues: { id: string; identifier: string; url: string; title: string }[] }[]>` keyed by transcript relative path
Reading a missing or malformed file returns defaults instead of throwing
Writes are atomic (write to temp file, then rename) so a crash cannot corrupt the file
Exported helpers: `getConfig()`, `updateConfig(partial)`, `addHistoryEntry(relPath, entry)`, `getHistory(relPath)`
pnpm typecheck passes

userStories.title: Filesystem scanner with path-traversal guard
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to safely list .md files under a user-chosen root so the explorer has data.
acceptanceCriteria: Module `lib/transcripts.ts` exports `resolveInsideRoot(root, relPath)` that throws when the resolved path escapes the root
Exports `listFolder(root, relPath)` returning subfolders and .md files for one folder level (not recursive)
Only files ending in `.md` are returned; dotfiles and `node_modules` are skipped
Each file entry includes: relPath, fileName, title, date, attendees, words, approxTokens, hasFrontmatter
YAML frontmatter is parsed with the `yaml` package; title/date/attendees come from it when present
When frontmatter is absent, title is derived from the filename and date from a leading YYYY-MM-DD pattern
Malformed frontmatter is treated as body text rather than throwing
Exports `readTranscript(root, relPath)` returning the parsed metadata and the body without frontmatter
pnpm typecheck passes

userStories.title: API routes for browsing folders and reading a transcript
userStories.description: As a frontend, I need HTTP endpoints so the explorer can list folders and load file contents.
acceptanceCriteria: `GET /api/browse?path=<relPath>` returns subfolders and .md files for that folder under the configured contextRoot
`GET /api/transcript?path=<relPath>` returns the transcript metadata and body
Both routes return HTTP 400 with a clear message when contextRoot is not configured
Both routes return HTTP 400 when the requested path escapes the root
Both routes return HTTP 404 when the path does not exist
pnpm typecheck passes

userStories.title: Settings UI: context folder path with recents
userStories.description: As a user, I want to type the path to my context folder and reuse recent ones so I do not retype it.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings page at `/settings` with a text input for the absolute folder path
An 'Abrir' button validates the folder exists and is readable, then saves it as contextRoot
Invalid or unreadable paths show an inline error and are not saved
Successfully opened folders are added to a recents list (max 8, most recent first, no duplicates)
Clicking a recent entry switches contextRoot to it
The currently active folder is visually marked in the recents list
pnpm typecheck passes
Verify in the browser at http://localhost:3300/settings that entering a valid path saves it and an invalid path shows an error

userStories.title: Settings UI: extraction provider selector
userStories.description: As a user, I want to choose between local Ollama and the Claude API so I can trade cost for quality.
acceptanceCriteria: Radio or segmented control choosing provider: 'Ollama (local, gratis)' or 'Claude API (de pago)'. Ollama is the default
When Ollama is selected, a dropdown lists installed models fetched from `GET {OLLAMA_URL}/api/tags`
When Ollama is unreachable or returns zero models, the dropdown is replaced by a message telling the user to run `ollama pull qwen3:8b`
`qwen3:8b` is preselected when present in the list
When Claude is selected, a password-type input accepts the Anthropic API key
A visible warning next to the Claude option reads that usage is billed per token against an Anthropic API account and is NOT included in a Claude Pro/Max subscription
Provider, model and API key persist via the config store
pnpm typecheck passes
Verify in the browser at http://localhost:3300/settings that switching providers shows the right controls and that the Ollama model list is populated

userStories.title: Settings UI: Linear API key
userStories.description: As a user, I want to store my Linear API key so the app can create issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Password-type input for the Linear API key on the settings page, persisted via the config store
A 'Probar' button calls a new `GET /api/linear/verify` route that queries the Linear GraphQL API for the organization name
On success the workspace name is shown; on failure the error message from Linear is shown
The key is never sent to the browser after being saved; the input shows a masked placeholder when a key is already stored
A short note states the key is stored unencrypted in the local .data folder
pnpm typecheck passes
Verify in the browser at http://localhost:3300/settings that saving a key and pressing 'Probar' reports the workspace name

userStories.title: Explorer UI: folder tree and file list
userStories.description: As a user, I want to navigate my context folder and see which files are meetings so I can pick one.
acceptanceCriteria: Main page shows a left panel with the folder tree of contextRoot, expandable and collapsible
Selecting a folder shows its .md files in a center list
Each file row shows title, date when known, attendee names when known, and approximate word count
Files are sorted by date descending, then by title
When contextRoot is not configured, the page shows a call to action linking to /settings
An empty folder shows an explicit empty state rather than a blank panel
pnpm typecheck passes
Verify in the browser at http://localhost:3300 that the tree navigates and the file list shows metadata

userStories.title: Transcript preview and already-processed notice
userStories.description: As a user, I want to read the transcript and know whether I already created issues from it.
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting a file loads its body into a scrollable preview panel
Markdown is rendered readably; long transcripts scroll without breaking the layout
When the config history has entries for that file, a notice appears above the preview reading how many tasks were created and on what date
The notice lists each previously created issue as a clickable link to Linear using its stored url and identifier
When there is no history for the file, no notice is shown
pnpm typecheck passes
Verify in the browser at http://localhost:3300 that selecting a file renders its content in the preview

userStories.title: Ollama extractor
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an extractor that turns a transcript into structured tasks using a local model.
acceptanceCriteria: Module `lib/extractors/ollama.ts` exports `extractWithOllama(transcript, meta, model)` returning a typed task array
The request sets `options.num_ctx` to at least 32768 so long transcripts are not silently truncated
The request sets `think: false` and uses Ollama structured output via the `format` field with a JSON Schema
Each task has: title, description, priority (urgent|high|medium|low|none), mentioned (string or null), evidence (verbatim quote)
The system prompt instructs the model to extract only real commitments, never invent tasks, and to answer in English
Tasks with an empty title are dropped; an unknown priority falls back to 'none'
A non-200 response or unparseable JSON throws an Error with an actionable message naming Ollama and the model
pnpm typecheck passes

userStories.title: Claude API extractor
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the same extraction available through the Anthropic API for higher quality.
acceptanceCriteria: Module `lib/extractors/claude.ts` exports `extractWithClaude(transcript, meta, apiKey)` returning the same typed task array as the Ollama extractor
Calls the Anthropic Messages API at https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages with headers `x-api-key` and `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01`
Uses model `claude-sonnet-5`
Uses structured outputs via `output_config.format` with the same JSON Schema as the Ollama extractor
Does NOT send `temperature`, `top_p` or `top_k`, which current models reject with HTTP 400
Checks `stop_reason` and throws a clear error when it is `refusal`, before reading content
A 401 response throws an error saying the Anthropic API key is invalid
Both extractors share one schema and one task TypeScript type, declared in a single module
pnpm typecheck passes

userStories.title: Extraction API route with provider dispatch
userStories.description: As a frontend, I need one endpoint that runs extraction with whichever provider is configured.
acceptanceCriteria: `POST /api/extract` accepts `{ path: string }` and returns `{ tasks: Task[] }`
Reads the configured provider from the config store and calls the matching extractor
Returns HTTP 400 with a clear message when the Claude provider is selected but no API key is stored
Returns HTTP 502 with the underlying message when the provider call fails
The transcript body sent to the extractor excludes YAML frontmatter
pnpm typecheck passes

userStories.title: Editable task table
userStories.description: As a user, I want to review, edit and curate the generated tasks before anything reaches Linear.
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Generar tareas' button calls /api/extract for the selected transcript and shows a loading state while running
Results render as a table with an include checkbox, editable title, editable description, and a priority dropdown per row
The evidence quote and mentioned person are visible per row, read-only
Rows can be deleted, and a blank row can be added manually
All rows are checked by default
A counter shows how many tasks are selected out of the total
An extraction error is shown inline with the message from the API, and the previous table is not cleared
pnpm typecheck passes
Verify in the browser at http://localhost:3300 that generating produces an editable table and edits persist while navigating within the page

userStories.title: Regenerate guard for manual edits
userStories.description: As a user, I do not want to silently lose edits when I regenerate tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: The app tracks whether any row was edited, added or deleted since the last extraction
Pressing 'Generar tareas' again with pending edits shows a confirmation naming how many manual changes will be discarded
Cancelling leaves the current table untouched
Confirming replaces the table with the newly extracted tasks and resets the edited flag
With no manual edits, regenerating proceeds without a confirmation
pnpm typecheck passes
Verify in the browser at http://localhost:3300 that editing a row then regenerating prompts for confirmation

userStories.title: Linear client: teams and projects
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to read the workspace structure so the user can pick a destination project.
acceptanceCriteria: Module `lib/linear.ts` exports `listTeamsAndProjects(apiKey)` querying the Linear GraphQL API
The Authorization header carries the API key verbatim, with no 'Bearer ' prefix
Returns teams with id, name, key and each team's projects with id and name
GraphQL errors returned in a HTTP 200 body are detected and thrown as errors
`GET /api/linear/projects` exposes the result to the frontend
pnpm typecheck passes

userStories.title: Linear client: create issue, with optional parent
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to create issues and attach them to a parent so a meeting groups its tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: `lib/linear.ts` exports `createIssue(apiKey, input)` using the `issueCreate` GraphQL mutation
Input supports teamId, title, description, priority, optional projectId and optional parentId
Priority maps to Linear integers: none=0, urgent=1, high=2, medium=3, low=4
Returns the created issue id, identifier and url
The description body appends a traceability block containing the source meeting title, its date, the mentioned person when present, and the evidence quote
Errors from Linear are surfaced with the message text, not a generic failure
pnpm typecheck passes

userStories.title: Push panel: project selector and parent task option
userStories.description: As a user, I want to choose the destination project and whether tasks group under a parent issue.
acceptanceCriteria: A panel below the task table shows a project dropdown populated from /api/linear/projects
The last used project is preselected from the config store and saved whenever it changes
When the workspace has exactly one team, it is used silently; when it has several, a team dropdown appears and filters the project list
A checkbox 'Crear tarea padre' is checked by default
When checked, a text input holds the parent title, prefilled with the transcript title and editable
The push button is disabled when no project is selected, no tasks are checked, or the Linear API key is missing, with the reason shown
pnpm typecheck passes
Verify in the browser at http://localhost:3300 that the project dropdown loads and the parent title prefills from the transcript

userStories.title: Push execution with progress, per-row status and retry
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see what happened to each task and retry only what failed.
acceptanceCriteria: `POST /api/linear/push` creates the parent issue first when requested, then each selected task as a sub-issue of it
Issues are created sequentially and progress is streamed or polled so the UI can show 'Creando N de M'
A failure on one task does not stop the run; remaining tasks are still attempted
Three consecutive failures abort the run and report that something is systematically wrong
Each row ends as created (with identifier and url), failed (with the error message), or pending
After a run with failures, the button becomes 'Reintentar N fallidas' and retries only failed rows
Rows already created are never sent again on retry
pnpm typecheck passes
Verify in the browser at http://localhost:3300 that pushing shows progress and per-row results

userStories.title: Push results summary and history persistence
userStories.description: As a user, I want the created issues linked and remembered so I do not duplicate work later.
acceptanceCriteria: On completion a summary reads 'N tareas creadas' and lists every created issue as a link showing its identifier and title
The parent issue, when created, is listed first and labelled as the parent
Every successful push appends an entry to the config history keyed by the transcript relative path, storing pushedAt and the created issues
Reopening that transcript later shows the already-processed notice from US-009 populated with these entries
Failed tasks are not written to history
pnpm typecheck passes
Verify in the browser at http://localhost:3300 that after a push the summary lists links and reopening the file shows the notice
